verdict.rationale: Bevy is distributed as a Rust crate via crates.io/cargo, not as an npm-style package for a JS toolchain — bevy-docs-21 explicitly frames it as 'just a normal Rust dependency' added via cargo, and web export happens via WASM compilation rather than JS bundler tree-shaking. No evidence shows Bevy installing into a JS package-manager workflow, being bundlable, or supporting tree-shaking semantics.
